Module catalog availability and tenant entitlements are explicit installation fixture configuration, not tenant database provisioning shortcuts.
Brain has no browser page in this revision. The proof checks its canonical schema and the non-superuser, non-bypass-RLS runtime role; Assessment and Support screens load through their real routes.
The original 11 local-identity specs are unchanged. The five new journeys use a separate database/server with real Better Auth signed sessions and HTTP invitation acceptance.
During adapter exploration, the Better Auth browser form emitted Origin:null and /auth/logout returned 404 in the harness. Those unowned routes remain unchanged.
